description: Add comprehensive test coverage for market data endpoints and rate limiter
steps: Create tests/test_market_endpoints.py with the following test cases:

(a) test_fetch_market_overview - Unit test for data.fetch_market_overview() with mocked yfinance. Verify it returns expected structure {as_of, items, source}. Mock yfinance.Ticker to return controlled prices.
(b) test_api_market_overview - Integration test for GET /api/market-overview endpoint via TestClient. Mock yfinance at module level. Verify 200 response with items array.
(c) test_api_hot_tickers - Integration test for GET /api/hot-tickers endpoint. Mock yfinance. Verify response structure {tickers: [...]} with expected fields.
(d) test_api_sparkline_valid - Integration test for GET /api/sparkline/AAPL. Mock yfinance history to return 30 days of prices. Verify response has prices array and trend field.
(e) test_api_sparkline_invalid - Test GET /api/sparkline/INVALID123456789 returns 400 or empty/error response.
(f) test_api_fear_greed - Integration test for GET /api/fear-greed endpoint. Verify response structure.

(g) test_rate_limiter - Test the IP-based rate limiter by sending 61 requests rapidly to an API endpoint and confirming the 61st returns 429. Also test that the per-ticker rate limiter (_check_rate_limit) returns False after 30 calls.
Ensure all new tests are self-contained with proper mocking (no real network calls).
Run the full test suite to confirm no regressions.
acceptance_criteria: Full test suite (448+ tests) passes with no regressions
verification: python -m pytest tests/test_market_endpoints.py -v --tb=short (all new tests pass)
findings: All 11 new tests pass. Full suite passes at 459 tests (448 existing + 11 new). Tests use unittest.mock.patch on augur.data._get_yfinance to avoid real network calls. Rate limiter tests work by importing _rate_limits/_rate_limit_lock from dashboard.app directly. conftest.py already resets IP rate limits between tests.
